Name: Kish, Son of Abdi
Summary: Kish, son of Abdi of the sons of Merari, was one of the Levites who arose to cleanse the house of the LORD under Hezekiah.
KeyStory: Of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi and Azariah the son of Jehalelel arose to cleanse the house.
RelatedPeople: Abdi, Father of Kish; King Hezekiah
LifeLesson: Merarites as well as Kohathites shared the cleansing work.
